[SWS_DM_00924] Event memory overflow reset condition
⌈
If there never
happened an overflow before (compare to [SWS_DM_00923]) or if the clear of all DTCs
was executed for a specific event memory, the DM shall from then on return false on
calling the function ara::diag::DTCInformation::GetEventMemoryOverflow
for this event memory instance.
⌋
